title: Project Sentinel Agent Reasoning & Execution Trace Log (LangSmith Compatible)
description: Schema for structured agent execution spans, multi-turn reasoning steps, LLM calls, tool interactions, and token metrics.

trace_id.description: Unique root trace identifier grouping all steps within a single analysis run.

run_id.description: Unique span identifier for this specific reasoning, LLM, or tool execution step.

parent_run_id.description: Parent span run_id for hierarchical call trees (e.g. tool execution called by LLM step).

group_id.description: Target AnalysisGroup identifier being processed in this reasoning turn.

step_index.description: Zero-indexed sequence number of the ReAct turn or execution stage.

run_type.description: Span type in LangSmith execution graph: chain (high-level flow), llm (model generation), tool (action invocation), retriever (knowledge search), guardrail (sanitization/PII), hitl (human approval).

start_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when step execution started.

end_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when step execution completed.

duration_ms.description: Elapsed execution time for this step in milliseconds.

status.description: Execution status outcome of the reasoning step.

inputs.description: Structured inputs supplied to the step (e.g. user prompt messages, tool arguments, query string, finding payload).

outputs.description: Structured output yielded by this step (e.g. LLM thought text, tool calls list, HTTP observation result, synthesized findings).

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt/input for this step.

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the completion/response for this step.

total_tokens.description: Total tokens consumed in this step (prompt_tokens + completion_tokens).
